note: Predeclared falsification criteria. These are declared BEFORE the independent review begins. A reviewer may discover additional failures; no reviewer or maintainer may weaken a mandatory criterion after review starts without producing a new freeze candidate (a new candidateId bound to a new source SHA).

criteria.statement: A required release-candidate package cannot be installed in a clean project outside the monorepo.
Execution of a documented reproduction step requires an OxDeAI monorepo-relative path.
Validation depends on an unpublished registry package that is not supplied in the RC bundle.
The documented public package interface cannot be invoked from the installed artifact.
A release-relevant corpus has ambiguous authority.
The same logical corpus has multiple independently editable authoritative representations.
A Profile-C secondary representation can diverge from its authority without detection.
A documented cross-language or cross-runtime claim is not supported by the declared consumers.
A third party cannot determine which corpus supports a stated conformance claim.
The documented commands do not reproduce the claimed result.
A recorded result cannot be tied to the frozen Git SHA.
A recorded result cannot be tied to the supplied RC artifacts.
The clean external result differs semantically from the recorded freeze result.
A freeze-blocking security defect accepted into the candidate remains reproducible against the frozen SHA.

Verification of an externally supplied authorization is self-bound to an expectation derived from the artifact under verification, from an artifact it carries, or from the producer that created it in the same call.
A known, reproduced issue permits execution outside the claimed frozen authorization boundary.
The frozen build requires a package-manager or toolchain state rejected by the accepted toolchain-security requirement.
Release-facing documentation claims a property that the frozen implementation or evidence bundle does not establish.
